en.headline: Meta AI rolls out in Hong Kong with Cantonese support
en.dek: The chatbot is available via its dedicated app and website from Friday, with integration into Facebook, Instagram, Threads and WhatsApp to follow.
body: Meta launched its Meta AI assistant in Hong Kong on Friday, offering local users access through a dedicated app and the meta.ai website.

The company said the service is designed with Cantonese language support and local cultural context. Features include real-time and deeper reasoning modes, plus image recognition that can identify items such as foreign-language menus or market produce and overlay labels.

Meta said the assistant will be rolled out gradually across its other apps including Facebook, Messenger, Instagram, Threads and WhatsApp. Local technology commentator Francis Fong said the launch lowers the barrier for everyday AI use in the city.

zh.headline: Meta AI正式登陸香港 支援廣東話及本地文化
zh.dek: 今日起可透過專屬應用及網站使用，稍後將陸續加入Facebook、Instagram、Threads及WhatsApp。
body: 科技公司Meta今日正式在香港推出人工智能助手Meta AI，用戶可即日起透過專屬應用程式及meta.ai網站使用。
Meta表示，是次推出的版本主打融入香港本地文化與廣東話用語，設有即時回應及深入思考兩種模式，並配備圖像識別功能，可辨識外語餐牌、街市食材等並加上標籤。
服務稍後將陸續加入Facebook、Messenger、Instagram、Threads及WhatsApp。本地科技評論員方保僑指，此舉有助降低市民日常應用人工智能的門檻。
